title: Choose the visual world — OSEP Notes (bolder hand)
question: Bolder hand: the dice dealt six foreign forms and the first dealt leads — Datamatics Field. Keep it, take one of the three full alternates, or re-roll. The normalled jackfield waits in the re-roll pool.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.lineage: datamatics — a data-sublime field of hairline barcode columns and sine lattices, monospace numerals at data density
options.thesis: The whole note set as one dense data field you scan by column, instead of a sidebar you scroll.
materials: monospace numerals in tight tabular columns
flat unmodulated hue at full strength
options.viewport: A full-bleed field of hairline bars carrying six flat hues across the whole first viewport, a monospace status strip above it — field status, signal index, frame — and the module set read as labelled columns inside the field rather than as cards.
options.risk: Data density suits numbers and is hostile to two-thousand-word prose; and the system owns no colour of its own, so the hues have to stay data or the world dies.

raised.raise: Monumental type as matter — the module title set at true display scale and allowed to break across lines like a weather front, instead of sitting politely in a heading slot.

options.note: Material translation, named as required: your brief pins colour, and this system is pure black and white. The translation keeps every structural rule — flat unmodulated fields, no gradient, no glow, no tint — and lets colour in only as the data itself: each module group is one fully saturated hue, and state is still never carried by hue.

regions.label: status strip · monospace field / signal / frame
monumental title · display scale, breaks across lines
module field · six flat hues, labelled columns
focus column · the selected numbers drawn out

options.label: Tab Board
options.lineage: a boxed-software reference manual — milk acetate leaves hinged over one full-strength section board, tabbed fore edge
options.thesis: Every division owns a board of one hue at full strength, and the leaf you read floats a millimetre above it.
materials: one full-strength board hue per division
milk acetate leaf with a punched bound edge
stepped tab rail down the fore edge
heads hanging in the fifth margin column
options.viewport: A full-strength chrome-yellow board carrying the division, a stepped tab rail down the fore edge whose heights show how long each division is, and the reading leaf floating above the board in a single serif measure.
options.case: Holds clarity best in the hand — a real 62-character reading measure, headings given their own margin column, and a tab rail whose heights encode extent. Loses audience identification narrowly: the boxed-manual era is remembered, not lived.
options.risk: The system reads nostalgic the moment the acetate stops doing real work.

options.label: Foundation Workshop
options.lineage: the Bauhaus foundation course — primary circle, square, and triangle tested as material exercises on a white worktable
options.thesis: Three primaries rationed by role: a red circle for the live item, a blue square for structure, a yellow triangle for the warning.
materials: point, line, and plane as the only ornament
options.viewport: A white worktable under a visible baseline grid: a lowercase headline at display scale, the module set laid out as geometric exercises in a strict grid, and the three primaries marking live, structural, and warning roles.
options.case: Holds clarity and colour at once — shape carries state so hue never has to, and lowercase geometric sans is the most legible display voice in the hand. Loses audience identification: the workshop is design history, not the reader's craft.
options.risk: Primaries on white are a well-known graphic register and go costume the moment the shapes stop meaning something.

options.label: Utility Protocol
options.lineage: industrial streetwear — literal words inside straight quotation marks, zip-tie tags left on, hazard diagonals on white cotton and black nylon
options.thesis: Everything is named literally inside quotes, and anything destructive wears the hazard stripe.
materials: stencilled label plates set square on the grid
options.viewport: A system of quote-marked label plates: every module named literally inside straight quotes, the active one keeping its orange zip tie on, and the authorized-use boundary and every irreversible step crossed by the hazard stripe.
options.case: Holds clarity exactly where it matters — the hazard stripe makes destructive steps and the authorized-use boundary unmissable, which this product genuinely needs. Loses identification: the stockroom is not the reader's world.
options.risk: Loud graphic grammar over dense prose tires quickly, and it is thin the moment the stripes stop marking real danger.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: letters condensing into weather — words bursting into rain and carving rivers
options.thesis: Language itself becomes the landscape, reshaping as the grammar changes.
materials: storm-letter black as both ink and mass
options.viewport: Type condenses into cloud, breaks into rain, and carves a river across the page as the reader moves between grammar fronts.
options.kept: Monumental type as matter — display set at true scale and allowed to behave like weather.
options.risk: Type as weather is an art piece; reading a procedure through it is not possible.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a technical notes site ships — sidebar taxonomy, hero, three equal cards, one blue accent — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a reader already expects from a documentation site, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other documentation site by design.
